description: 土砂災害警戒区域シェープデータ [landslides and debris flows and disaster risk and hazard maps] is a dataset listed in BODIK Open Data Catalogue Service (data.bodik.jp), Japanese local governments, an open data portal, published or maintained by 栃木県. 栃木県内の土砂災害警戒区域の位置や範囲を示した図形データ. Coverage: 栃木県. The portal files it under the publisher 栃木県. Its tags are 土砂災害, 建設, 災害, 防災. It offers 13 resource(s) in application/vnd.dbf, qgis, zip. The portal shows 2026-08-07 as the last metadata change. The title and description are in Japanese; the topic words in square brackets are the cataloguer's translation of the title. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is other licence as labelled on the portal (terms not stated). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support infrastructure hazard and exposure studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-jp-bodik-portal.
